local_proxy_concurrency_400.origin: Local frozen comparison broker activeRequest guard after requester abort releases product queue early.
local_proxy_concurrency_400.role: foreground caller rejected while auxiliary title is still active
local_proxy_concurrency_400.mandatoryUsage: These rejected local requests never reach upstream and have no provider usage; active title calls are accounted separately.
local_proxy_concurrency_400.queueCorrectionAlone: Addresses this specific race by retaining the slot through broker/accounting settlement. It does not prove the eventual task succeeds or remaining title usage is known.

local_finalization_cancelled_title_fallb.origin: Product finalization abort of pending upstream work, converted by broker to local HTTP502 transport error.
local_finalization_cancelled_title_fallb.queueCorrectionAlone: Not guaranteed. These occurred in race-affected arms, but corrected scheduling cannot establish what an uncancelled title would have returned.

claimLimits: 46/48 Hermes arms have unknown mandatory whole-trajectory usage because of provider title errors; queue correction does not remove this accounting limitation.

Do not derive parity/superiority from accounting-driven zeros, exclude affected attempts selectively, rewrite scores, or treat missing usage as zero tokens.
A provider HTTP400 does not prove it consumed no generated tokens. No billing or subscription-quota inference is available.
